records.rationale: Insulation erosion and eventual breakdown are valid concerns, but the answer reduces PD to an internal process and broadly says it is hard to detect until too late. evidence.finding: Output capacitance and ESR influence feedback-loop poles/zeros and regulator stability.

evidence.title: TI switching regulator fundamentals
evidence.finding: Page 14 explains increased ripple and possible loop instability from high output-capacitor ESR.

records.rationale: Correct basic load-cell definition with strain gauges as a common rather than exclusive implementation. It describes force/weight transduction without claiming the cell alone performs calibration, display or complete weighing-system compensation.

evidence.finding: Applied force elastically strains the load member; in a strain-gauge cell that changes bridge resistance/output, providing an electrical signal related to force.

records.rationale: The definition incorrectly equates a safety rating/certification with predictable safe failure. Recognized components are assessed against specific requirements and conditions of acceptability within a system; failure-mode behavior depends on the component and standard. evidence.title: UL component testing and certification
evidence.finding: Recognition assesses applicable requirements under defined conditions of acceptability within an end product; it does not guarantee every component fails safely under arbitrary faults.

evidence.title: TI Power Supply Design insulation definitions

records.rationale: Faithful plain-language description of gyro integration drift. Position estimate is read as angular position/orientation in the gyroscope context, not a claim that integrating angular rate once produces linear displacement.

evidence.title: Analog Devices AN-1057 inclination sensing
evidence.finding: An accelerometer gives a gravity-based tilt reference only under appropriate acceleration assumptions; sustained non-gravity acceleration biases tilt, while gyro integration accumulates drift.
Integrating a constant angular-rate bias b over time t adds an angular error b*t; zero-mean rate noise can also accumulate uncertainty.

records.rationale: Correct conventional full-wave rectifier topologies and comparison with half-wave rectification of a comparable AC waveform. The output is pulsating DC with both halves used; smoother does not claim ripple-free output without filtering.

evidence.finding: For an ideal sine of peak Vm, average |sin| output is 2*Vm/pi versus Vm/pi for half-wave, and pulse repetition is twice the input frequency.

records.rationale: MOV/TVS/GDT options and clearing a hard MOV short are sensible, but the mains MOV-plus-fuse recommendation omits thermal-runaway coordination. Hold that safety-relevant incompleteness; no assertion is made that every properly coordinated MOV/fuse design is unsafe.

records.rationale: Gravity-based accelerometer roll/pitch sensing is correct, but adding a gyro is framed as long-term accuracy improvement without motion or fusion conditions. Hold that unqualified recommendation rather than rejecting sensor fusion generally.

records.rationale: Correct distinction between near-zero-voltage turn-on suited to burst switching and random turn-on needed for firing-angle control. evidence.title: OMRON zero-cross SSR function
evidence.finding: Zero-cross turn-on waits near zero AC load voltage to reduce switching noise, which differs from arbitrary phase-angle triggering.
A zero-cross gate waits near the start of a half-cycle, preventing freely chosen within-half-cycle firing angles; a random-turn-on gate can trigger at the commanded phase.
